## OpenAI Pricing Updates

OpenAI commercial pricing is primarily usage and seat based, with enterprise terms negotiated around volume, data controls, support, and model access.

## Key Price Changes
- ChatGPT Enterprise: Typically negotiated by seat count, usage profile, and support requirements
- API usage: Consumption-based pricing varies by model, input/output tokens, and latency needs
- Premium model access: Higher capability models require stricter budgeting and usage controls

## Business Impact
- Costs can scale quickly when AI workflows move from pilots to production
- Token usage governance is essential for predictable spend
- Enterprise contracts should include usage dashboards, rate limits, and renewal protections

## What This Means
- Negotiate committed-use discounts and overage protections
- Require clear data retention and model training exclusions
- Set internal policies for which use cases can access premium models
